svg.title: Spatially grounded tensor-to-LLM interface
svg.desc: A two-stage architecture. In Stage 1, shared input X branches to a value-preserving encoder and a frozen Qwen tokenizer; the paired outputs are read after short probes at frozen Qwen layer ell and aligned with a field-text contrastive matrix. Stage 2 places the same 256 spatial tokens directly before a natural-language question in a frozen Qwen model.

g.text: One spatial token per grid cell; alignment first, natural-language grounding second
shared input X, paired probes, shared shallow Qwen
Stage-1 checkpoint: encoder Eφ + native spatial adapter Aθ
reuse native modules; cache Z during training
task instruction, coordinates, choices, optional μ/σ
Aθ sees Z only; the question bypasses the adapter
No decoder at inference | no Stage-1 whitening/alignment head in Stage 2 | no parsed coordinates or task-specific numerical head

svg.text: Spatial identity is preserved by constant token count and row-major indexing; attention contextualizes each token without pooling it away.
